spec.title: OpenWrt - NetFlow
spec.description: Per-flow traffic from softflowd via Akvorado, stored in ClickHouse, plus the exporter and collector health that says whether it is complete.

options.content:
## Per-flow traffic
NetFlow v9 from softflowd on the router, collected by Akvorado and stored in ClickHouse. Byte counts are multiplied by the reported sampling rate.

**Coverage caveat:** softflowd captures with libpcap, so traffic forwarded by the switch ASIC under hardware flow offload never reaches it. Check the **Pipeline Health** tab before treating these totals as complete.

spec.title: Flows
spec.description: Flow records stored in the selected range.

spec.rawSql: SELECT count() AS flows FROM flows WHERE $__timeFilter(TimeReceived) AND $__conditionalAll(ExporterName IN (${router:singlequote}), $router)

spec.title: Traffic
spec.description: Total bytes in the selected range, sampling-rate corrected.

spec.rawSql: SELECT sum(Bytes * SamplingRate) AS bytes FROM flows WHERE $__timeFilter(TimeReceived) AND $__conditionalAll(ExporterName IN (${router:singlequote}), $router)

spec.title: Peak Bitrate
spec.description: Highest sampling-rate-corrected bitrate bucket in the selected range.

spec.rawSql: SELECT max(bps) AS bps FROM (SELECT $__timeInterval(TimeReceived) AS time, sum(Bytes * SamplingRate) * 8 / $__interval_s AS bps FROM flows WHERE $__timeFilter(TimeReceived) AND $__conditionalAll(ExporterName IN (${router:singlequote}), $router) GROUP BY time)

spec.title: Local Hosts
spec.description: Distinct local source addresses seen. Depends on the `networks` prefixes in akvorado.yaml matching your addressing.

spec.rawSql: SELECT uniq(SrcAddr) AS hosts FROM flows WHERE $__timeFilter(TimeReceived) AND $__conditionalAll(ExporterName IN (${router:singlequote}), $router) AND SrcNetRole = 'internal'

spec.title: External Peers
spec.description: Distinct internet-side addresses contacted.

spec.rawSql: SELECT uniq(DstAddr) AS peers FROM flows WHERE $__timeFilter(TimeReceived) AND $__conditionalAll(ExporterName IN (${router:singlequote}), $router) AND DstNetRole != 'internal'

spec.title: ASN Coverage
spec.description: Share of boundary-crossing flows with a source or destination AS after GeoIP/ASN enrichment.

spec.rawSql: SELECT round(100 * countIf(SrcAS != 0 OR DstAS != 0) / greatest(count(), 1)) AS pct FROM flows WHERE $__timeFilter(TimeReceived) AND $__conditionalAll(ExporterName IN (${router:singlequote}), $router) AND (SrcNetRole != 'internal' OR DstNetRole != 'internal')

spec.title: Throughput by Direction
spec.description:
Bit rate split into outbound, inbound, and LAN-local, derived from whether each address falls in one of the `clickhouse.networks` prefixes in akvorado.yaml.

This deliberately does NOT use InIfBoundary: softflowd reports the same ifIndex for both ingress and egress, so interface boundary is constant across every flow and cannot distinguish direction. If everything lands in one series, your LAN prefix is missing from `clickhouse.networks`.

spec.rawSql: SELECT $__timeInterval(TimeReceived) AS time, multiIf(SrcNetRole = 'internal' AND DstNetRole = 'internal', 'local', SrcNetRole = 'internal', 'outbound', 'inbound') AS direction, sum(Bytes * SamplingRate) * 8 / $__interval_s AS bps FROM flows WHERE $__timeFilter(TimeReceived) AND $__conditionalAll(ExporterName IN (${router:singlequote}), $router) GROUP BY time, direction ORDER BY time

spec.title: Top Local Talkers
spec.description: Busiest local sources by uploaded bytes. Raw `flows` table only, so bounded by the interval-0 retention window.

spec.rawSql: SELECT IPv6NumToString(SrcAddr) AS host, sum(Bytes * SamplingRate) AS bytes FROM flows WHERE $__timeFilter(TimeReceived) AND $__conditionalAll(ExporterName IN (${router:singlequote}), $router) AND SrcNetRole = 'internal' GROUP BY host ORDER BY bytes DESC LIMIT 15

spec.title: Top External Destinations
spec.description: Busiest internet-side destinations by bytes.

spec.rawSql: SELECT IPv6NumToString(DstAddr) AS peer, sum(Bytes * SamplingRate) AS bytes FROM flows WHERE $__timeFilter(TimeReceived) AND $__conditionalAll(ExporterName IN (${router:singlequote}), $router) AND DstNetRole != 'internal' GROUP BY peer ORDER BY bytes DESC LIMIT 15

spec.title: Top Conversations
spec.description: Individual source/destination/port conversations, heaviest first. This is the panel that answers 'what is saturating the link right now'.

spec.rawSql: SELECT IPv6NumToString(SrcAddr) AS Source, IPv6NumToString(DstAddr) AS Destination, DstPort AS Port, dictGetOrDefault('protocols', 'name', toUInt64(Proto), toString(Proto)) AS Protocol, sum(Bytes * SamplingRate) AS Bytes, sum(Packets * SamplingRate) AS Packets FROM flows WHERE $__timeFilter(TimeReceived) AND $__conditionalAll(ExporterName IN (${router:singlequote}), $router) GROUP BY Source, Destination, Port, Protocol ORDER BY Bytes DESC LIMIT 50

options.content:
## Ports and protocols
Port numbers are a weak proxy for application identity -- almost everything is 443/TCP now. For real application labels, install the `dpi` profile (Netifyd) and use the Advanced dashboard; this tab answers 'which service ports and protocols carry the bytes', not 'which app'.

spec.title: Top Destination Ports
spec.description: Internet-side destination ports by bytes. This is usually the most useful port ranking for web, DNS, streaming, VPN, and gaming traffic.

spec.rawSql: SELECT concat(toString(DstPort), '/', dictGetOrDefault('protocols', 'name', toUInt64(Proto), toString(Proto))) AS port, sum(Bytes * SamplingRate) AS bytes FROM flows WHERE $__timeFilter(TimeReceived) AND $__conditionalAll(ExporterName IN (${router:singlequote}), $router) AND DstNetRole != 'internal' GROUP BY port ORDER BY bytes DESC LIMIT 15

spec.title: Top Source Ports
spec.description: Source ports by bytes. Expect many ephemeral client ports here; fixed source ports such as 443/UDP or 9100/TCP are the interesting exceptions.

spec.rawSql: SELECT concat(toString(SrcPort), '/', dictGetOrDefault('protocols', 'name', toUInt64(Proto), toString(Proto))) AS port, sum(Bytes * SamplingRate) AS bytes FROM flows WHERE $__timeFilter(TimeReceived) AND $__conditionalAll(ExporterName IN (${router:singlequote}), $router) AND SrcPort > 0 GROUP BY port ORDER BY bytes DESC LIMIT 15

spec.title: Protocol Mix
spec.description: Share of bytes by IP protocol.

spec.rawSql: SELECT dictGetOrDefault('protocols', 'name', toUInt64(Proto), toString(Proto)) AS protocol, sum(Bytes * SamplingRate) AS bytes FROM flows WHERE $__timeFilter(TimeReceived) AND $__conditionalAll(ExporterName IN (${router:singlequote}), $router) GROUP BY protocol ORDER BY bytes DESC LIMIT 10

spec.title: Throughput by Destination Port
spec.description: Bit rate over time for the eight busiest destination ports in the range.

spec.rawSql: SELECT $__timeInterval(TimeReceived) AS time, toString(DstPort) AS port, sum(Bytes * SamplingRate) * 8 / $__interval_s AS bps FROM flows WHERE $__timeFilter(TimeReceived) AND $__conditionalAll(ExporterName IN (${router:singlequote}), $router) AND DstNetRole != 'internal' AND DstPort IN (SELECT DstPort FROM flows WHERE $__timeFilter(TimeReceived) AND $__conditionalAll(ExporterName IN (${router:singlequote}), $router) AND DstNetRole != 'internal' GROUP BY DstPort ORDER BY sum(Bytes * SamplingRate) DESC LIMIT 8) GROUP BY time, port ORDER BY time

spec.title: Service Class Mix
spec.description: Human-readable service buckets from source and destination ports. This is a convenience grouping, not DPI.

spec.rawSql: SELECT multiIf(DstPort IN (53, 853) OR SrcPort IN (53, 853), 'DNS / encrypted DNS', DstPort IN (80, 443, 8080, 8443) OR SrcPort IN (80, 443, 8080, 8443), 'Web / QUIC', DstPort IN (9100, 9090, 3000, 8081, 8123) OR SrcPort IN (9100, 9090, 3000, 8081, 8123), 'Monitoring stack', DstPort IN (22, 2222) OR SrcPort IN (22, 2222), 'SSH / admin', DstPort = 123 OR SrcPort = 123, 'NTP', DstPort = 5353 OR SrcPort = 5353, 'mDNS', DstPort = 1900 OR SrcPort = 1900, 'SSDP / discovery', 'Other') AS service, sum(Bytes * SamplingRate) AS bytes FROM flows WHERE $__timeFilter(TimeReceived) AND $__conditionalAll(ExporterName IN (${router:singlequote}), $router) GROUP BY service ORDER BY bytes DESC

spec.title: Packet Size Distribution
spec.description: Packet size buckets. A distribution skewed to small packets alongside high packet rates is a useful signal for interactive vs bulk traffic, and for scan-like behaviour.

spec.rawSql: SELECT PacketSizeBucket AS Bucket, sum(Packets * SamplingRate) AS Packets, sum(Bytes * SamplingRate) AS Bytes FROM flows WHERE $__timeFilter(TimeReceived) AND $__conditionalAll(ExporterName IN (${router:singlequote}), $router) GROUP BY Bucket ORDER BY Packets DESC

spec.title: TCP Flag Combinations
spec.description: Raw TCP flag bitmasks. Large numbers of flows carrying only SYN (2) are the classic signature of a scan or of a service that is refusing connections.

spec.rawSql: SELECT TCPFlags AS Flags, count() AS Flows, sum(Bytes * SamplingRate) AS Bytes FROM flows WHERE $__timeFilter(TimeReceived) AND $__conditionalAll(ExporterName IN (${router:singlequote}), $router) AND Proto = 6 GROUP BY Flags ORDER BY Flows DESC LIMIT 20

spec.title: Top Local Service Ports
spec.description: Ports receiving traffic on internal destinations. Useful for spotting local scrapes, media servers, admin interfaces, and noisy LAN services.

spec.rawSql: SELECT concat(toString(DstPort), '/', dictGetOrDefault('protocols', 'name', toUInt64(Proto), toString(Proto))) AS port, sum(Bytes * SamplingRate) AS bytes FROM flows WHERE $__timeFilter(TimeReceived) AND $__conditionalAll(ExporterName IN (${router:singlequote}), $router) AND DstNetRole = 'internal' AND DstPort > 0 GROUP BY port ORDER BY bytes DESC LIMIT 15

spec.title: Port Conversation Matrix
spec.description: Source-to-destination port pairs. This makes fixed source-port services stand out from ordinary client ephemeral ports.

spec.rawSql: SELECT concat(toString(SrcPort), ' -> ', toString(DstPort), '/', dictGetOrDefault('protocols', 'name', toUInt64(Proto), toString(Proto))) AS PortPath, count() AS Flows, sum(Bytes * SamplingRate) AS Bytes, sum(Packets * SamplingRate) AS Packets FROM flows WHERE $__timeFilter(TimeReceived) AND $__conditionalAll(ExporterName IN (${router:singlequote}), $router) AND SrcPort > 0 AND DstPort > 0 GROUP BY PortPath ORDER BY Bytes DESC LIMIT 40

options.content:
## Autonomous systems and geography
ASN and country enrichment comes from the MaxMind/IPinfo databases mounted in `akvorado/geoip/`. When the databases are missing, Akvorado still stores flows but AS, country, city, and network labels stay empty. The resolution tiles below make that state explicit.

Read source-side panels as **who sent traffic to you or to local services** and destination-side panels as **where your clients sent traffic**. On a home LAN most source ports are ephemeral; AS and destination ports are usually the cleaner story.

spec.title: Destination AS Resolution
spec.description: Share of outbound/external-destination flows that resolved to a destination AS number.

spec.rawSql: SELECT round(100 * countIf(DstAS != 0) / greatest(count(), 1)) AS pct FROM flows WHERE $__timeFilter(TimeReceived) AND $__conditionalAll(ExporterName IN (${router:singlequote}), $router) AND DstNetRole != 'internal'

spec.title: Source AS Resolution
spec.description: Share of internet-source flows that resolved to a source AS number.

spec.rawSql: SELECT round(100 * countIf(SrcAS != 0) / greatest(count(), 1)) AS pct FROM flows WHERE $__timeFilter(TimeReceived) AND $__conditionalAll(ExporterName IN (${router:singlequote}), $router) AND SrcNetRole != 'internal'

spec.title: Country Resolution
spec.description: Share of boundary-crossing flows with either side resolved to a non-empty country code.

spec.rawSql: SELECT round(100 * countIf(replaceRegexpAll(toString(SrcCountry), '\\x00', '') != '' OR replaceRegexpAll(toString(DstCountry), '\\x00', '') != '') / greatest(count(), 1)) AS pct FROM flows WHERE $__timeFilter(TimeReceived) AND $__conditionalAll(ExporterName IN (${router:singlequote}), $router) AND (SrcNetRole != 'internal' OR DstNetRole != 'internal')

spec.title: External Share
spec.description: Share of bytes crossing the local network boundary rather than staying LAN-local. Derived from address role, not interface boundary.

spec.rawSql: SELECT round(100 * sumIf(Bytes * SamplingRate, (SrcNetRole != 'internal' OR DstNetRole != 'internal')) / greatest(sum(Bytes * SamplingRate), 1)) AS pct FROM flows WHERE $__timeFilter(TimeReceived) AND $__conditionalAll(ExporterName IN (${router:singlequote}), $router)

spec.title: Top Destination AS
spec.description: Networks your traffic actually goes to, by bytes. Requires GeoIP/ASN.

spec.rawSql: SELECT concat('AS', toString(DstAS), ' ', dictGetOrDefault('asns', 'name', toUInt64(DstAS), '')) AS asn, sum(Bytes * SamplingRate) AS bytes FROM flows WHERE $__timeFilter(TimeReceived) AND $__conditionalAll(ExporterName IN (${router:singlequote}), $router) AND DstNetRole != 'internal' AND DstAS != 0 GROUP BY asn ORDER BY bytes DESC LIMIT 15

spec.title: Top Source AS
spec.description: Internet-side source networks by bytes. This is the panel to inspect for inbound traffic or remote services sending data to the LAN.

spec.rawSql: SELECT concat('AS', toString(SrcAS), ' ', dictGetOrDefault('asns', 'name', toUInt64(SrcAS), '')) AS asn, sum(Bytes * SamplingRate) AS bytes FROM flows WHERE $__timeFilter(TimeReceived) AND $__conditionalAll(ExporterName IN (${router:singlequote}), $router) AND SrcNetRole != 'internal' AND SrcAS != 0 GROUP BY asn ORDER BY bytes DESC LIMIT 15

spec.title: Top Destination Country
spec.description: Destination countries by bytes. Requires GeoIP.

spec.rawSql: SELECT replaceRegexpAll(toString(DstCountry), '\\x00', '') AS country, sum(Bytes * SamplingRate) AS bytes FROM flows WHERE $__timeFilter(TimeReceived) AND $__conditionalAll(ExporterName IN (${router:singlequote}), $router) AND DstNetRole != 'internal' AND replaceRegexpAll(toString(DstCountry), '\\x00', '') != '' GROUP BY country ORDER BY bytes DESC LIMIT 15

spec.title: Top Source Country
spec.description: Internet-side source countries by bytes. Missing countries are stripped instead of showing ClickHouse FixedString NUL bytes.

spec.rawSql: SELECT replaceRegexpAll(toString(SrcCountry), '\\x00', '') AS country, sum(Bytes * SamplingRate) AS bytes FROM flows WHERE $__timeFilter(TimeReceived) AND $__conditionalAll(ExporterName IN (${router:singlequote}), $router) AND SrcNetRole != 'internal' AND replaceRegexpAll(toString(SrcCountry), '\\x00', '') != '' GROUP BY country ORDER BY bytes DESC LIMIT 15

spec.title: Throughput by Destination AS
spec.description: Bit rate to the eight busiest destination networks. Requires GeoIP/ASN.

spec.rawSql: SELECT $__timeInterval(TimeReceived) AS time, concat('AS', toString(DstAS)) AS asn, sum(Bytes * SamplingRate) * 8 / $__interval_s AS bps FROM flows WHERE $__timeFilter(TimeReceived) AND $__conditionalAll(ExporterName IN (${router:singlequote}), $router) AND DstNetRole != 'internal' AND DstAS != 0 AND DstAS IN (SELECT DstAS FROM flows WHERE $__timeFilter(TimeReceived) AND $__conditionalAll(ExporterName IN (${router:singlequote}), $router) AND DstNetRole != 'internal' AND DstAS != 0 GROUP BY DstAS ORDER BY sum(Bytes * SamplingRate) DESC LIMIT 8) GROUP BY time, asn ORDER BY time

spec.title: Throughput by Source AS
spec.description: Bit rate from the eight busiest source networks. Useful for inbound traffic and remote services that send large responses.

spec.rawSql: SELECT $__timeInterval(TimeReceived) AS time, concat('AS', toString(SrcAS)) AS asn, sum(Bytes * SamplingRate) * 8 / $__interval_s AS bps FROM flows WHERE $__timeFilter(TimeReceived) AND $__conditionalAll(ExporterName IN (${router:singlequote}), $router) AND SrcNetRole != 'internal' AND SrcAS != 0 AND SrcAS IN (SELECT SrcAS FROM flows WHERE $__timeFilter(TimeReceived) AND $__conditionalAll(ExporterName IN (${router:singlequote}), $router) AND SrcNetRole != 'internal' AND SrcAS != 0 GROUP BY SrcAS ORDER BY sum(Bytes * SamplingRate) DESC LIMIT 8) GROUP BY time, asn ORDER BY time

spec.title: AS Conversation Matrix
spec.description: Who is talking to whom at the AS level, with local or unresolved sides grouped as AS0. This makes CDN, resolver, cloud, and remote-service relationships visible in one sortable table.

spec.rawSql: SELECT concat('AS', toString(SrcAS), ' ', dictGetOrDefault('asns', 'name', toUInt64(SrcAS), '')) AS SourceAS, concat('AS', toString(DstAS), ' ', dictGetOrDefault('asns', 'name', toUInt64(DstAS), '')) AS DestinationAS, count() AS Flows, uniq(SrcAddr) AS Sources, uniq(DstAddr) AS Destinations, sum(Bytes * SamplingRate) AS Bytes, sum(Packets * SamplingRate) AS Packets FROM flows WHERE $__timeFilter(TimeReceived) AND $__conditionalAll(ExporterName IN (${router:singlequote}), $router) AND (SrcAS != 0 OR DstAS != 0) GROUP BY SourceAS, DestinationAS ORDER BY Bytes DESC LIMIT 50

spec.title: Country Pair Matrix
spec.description: Country-to-country pairs after stripping missing FixedString values. This is a compact way to see where traffic is going without exposing individual IPs.

spec.rawSql: SELECT if(replaceRegexpAll(toString(SrcCountry), '\\x00', '') = '', 'unresolved', replaceRegexpAll(toString(SrcCountry), '\\x00', '')) AS SourceCountry, if(replaceRegexpAll(toString(DstCountry), '\\x00', '') = '', 'unresolved', replaceRegexpAll(toString(DstCountry), '\\x00', '')) AS DestinationCountry, count() AS Flows, sum(Bytes * SamplingRate) AS Bytes FROM flows WHERE $__timeFilter(TimeReceived) AND $__conditionalAll(ExporterName IN (${router:singlequote}), $router) AND (SrcNetRole != 'internal' OR DstNetRole != 'internal') GROUP BY SourceCountry, DestinationCountry ORDER BY Bytes DESC LIMIT 50

spec.title: Top Geo Cities
spec.description: City-level enrichment when the mounted GeoIP database provides it. Empty is normal with country-only databases.

spec.rawSql: SELECT multiIf(DstGeoCity != '', concat(replaceRegexpAll(toString(DstCountry), '\\x00', ''), ' / ', DstGeoCity), SrcGeoCity != '', concat(replaceRegexpAll(toString(SrcCountry), '\\x00', ''), ' / ', SrcGeoCity), 'unresolved') AS City, count() AS Flows, sum(Bytes * SamplingRate) AS Bytes FROM flows WHERE $__timeFilter(TimeReceived) AND $__conditionalAll(ExporterName IN (${router:singlequote}), $router) AND (SrcNetRole != 'internal' OR DstNetRole != 'internal') AND (DstGeoCity != '' OR SrcGeoCity != '') GROUP BY City ORDER BY Bytes DESC LIMIT 50

options.content:
## Is the flow data trustworthy?
Everything on this tab is Prometheus, not ClickHouse. The flow pipeline has three failure modes that produce *plausible but wrong* data rather than an error:

1. **Hardware flow offload** -- packets forwarded by the switch ASIC never reach softflowd.
2. **libpcap drops** -- the router could not keep up and flows are missing packets.
3. **Flow table overflow** -- `max_flows` was hit, so flows expired early and byte counts are truncated.

All three are surfaced below. Treat a non-zero value in any of them as 'the numbers on the other tabs are a lower bound'.

spec.title: Exporter Running
spec.description: Whether every configured softflowd instance answered on its control socket. Reads 0 if any capture interface has no live exporter.

spec.title: Flow Data Complete
spec.description: 0 means hardware flow offload is enabled, so the switch ASIC forwards traffic the CPU never sees and softflowd cannot capture it. Flow totals are then incomplete by an unknown amount. Set NETFLOW_DISABLE_HW_OFFLOAD=1 when running setup.sh to trade routing throughput for complete accounting.

spec.title: Capture Drops
spec.description: Packets libpcap discarded because softflowd could not keep up. Anything above zero means flows are missing packets; reduce the captured interface set or raise NETFLOW_SAMPLING_RATE.

spec.title: Forced Flow Expiry
spec.description: Flows expired early because the softflowd flow table was full. Non-zero truncates byte counts; raise NETFLOW_MAX_FLOWS.

spec.title: Router Exporter Rates
spec.description: softflowd's own counters. Export failures mean the router could not send to the collector -- check the inlet is reachable on the NetFlow port.

spec.title: Collector Pipeline Rates
spec.description:
Akvorado's own counters, scraped as job="akvorado". Two gaps to read here:

- **inlet kernel drops** above zero means the UDP receive buffer overflowed. Akvorado's docs are explicit that this makes byte and packet counts unreliable, because the reported sampling rate no longer matches what actually arrived.
- **received but not stored** means enrichment is dropping flows. Almost always an ifIndex that akvorado/exporters.yaml does not know. The breakdown panel below names the exact reason.

spec.title: Capture Interfaces and ifIndex
spec.description: The ifIndex column is what must match akvorado/exporters.yaml. A mismatch discards every flow from that interface with no error anywhere -- it looks identical to NetFlow not working at all.

spec.title: Flow Table Occupancy
spec.description: Flows currently tracked by softflowd. Approaching NETFLOW_MAX_FLOWS (8192 by default) is what causes the forced expiry above.

spec.title: Collector Available
spec.description: Whether the health collector itself ran and reached at least one exporter. 0 with the netflow profile installed means softflowctl is missing or every instance is down.

spec.title: Export Failures
spec.description: Flows softflowd could not send to the collector over the selected range. Non-zero means UDP to the Akvorado inlet is failing.

spec.title: Textfile Freshness
spec.description: Age of the router's textfile metrics, including this collector's output. A stale value means cron is not running the health script.

spec.title: Collector Error Reasons
spec.description: Why the outlet discarded flows over the selected range, by Akvorado's own reason label. 'metadata missing' means the ifIndex is not in akvorado/exporters.yaml - the most likely failure on a fresh install. 'sampling rate missing' is normal briefly at startup but should stop increasing; if it keeps climbing, akvorado.yaml's default-sampling-rate is not taking effect. Empty is the healthy state.
